basis: Visual proportions and construction read from the named primary catalog photographs; not measured manufacturer dimensions.

kutovyy-dyvan-neo-2.observation: Two uninterrupted upholstered seat/front shells. Stitching compresses each shell; there are no separate narrow strip cushions or detached headrests.

hilton-p.observation: Long chaise on the left and a shorter right-hand seating return with inward-facing back cushions; the two ends are not equal ottomans.

pryamyy-dyvan-loft.observation: Two tall upholstered front modules with edge welts, not thin cushions above a second plinth. Two large loose back pillows and two yellow throws.

lizhko-faro.observation: One upholstered patterned headboard and two half-width banks of timber slats divided by a centre support.

delta.observation: One continuous seat over a dark base; two-tone asymmetric swept back and one loose pillow. No conventional sofa arms or multiple back cushions.
